releases.notes:
Hi there! This release is rather small and adds just a couple of new rules and fixes a few bugs. Yet again, the **Tinker Kit** has changed to allow other modders to fully register their own tinker types, commands and blocks which is very exciting, but probably not applicable to the experiences of most!
***

### Additions
- 2 new rules:
  - `disableArmadilloShedding`
  - `disableWaterMiningSlowdown`
 
- Full **Tinker Kit** registration support. Wiki page coming soon™️.
***

### Removals
- `observerHalfDelay`
  - Due to the orientable nature of observers, it didn't really make sense to make redstone ore *beneath* them do the work. Additionally, this rule was hard to integrate alongside the **Tinker Kit**'s behaviors so it was best to just remove it.
***

### Fixes
- Monsters now correctly spawn in nether fortresses and other locations. This has hopefully led to a drastic improvement in the reliability of the `peacefulMonsterSpawning` rule. #12 
- Dedicated servers no longer crash when firing a dispenser pointing into sand or gravel with `dispensersBuryItems` enabled.
- Slightly improved the performance of the `/randomtick` command behavior.

releases.notes:
![cover](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a41489b1-8a6b-4437-ac6d-acd15dbf9418)

Hey! After much deliberation, I have finally stabilized **Doormat** enough for a new release! This update is relatively small on the surface, but with 2 new **Tinker Kit** commands and a fix for the oldest bug in the history of this mod, it's still nothing to be sniffed at!
***

### Changes
- The functionality of `endPlatformSillyString` has been slightly tweaked to allow you to fully restore the behavior of pre-1.21. The `delete_string` option has been refactored to `no_drops`, and prevents all blocks from dropping as items instead of just string.
- The `only_pattern` option for `compactTrimTooltips` has been renamed to `no_material`.
- `cryingObsidianPortalFrames` has been changed from a Boolean rule to an enumerator with options `true`, `false` and `convert`. `convert` handles the functionality that was previously controlled by `obsidianFrameConversionChance`.
- `stoneGenProduct`, `cobblestoneGenProduct`, `basaltGenProduct` and `obsidianGenProduct` now accept lists of block IDs, from which a random selection will be made whenever the block is formed.
***

### Additions
- 9 new rules:
  - `commandDelay`
  - `commandTickPriority`
  - `disablePiglinBlockGuarding`
  - `expandedFenceConnectivity`
  - `itemMagnetRange`
  - `itemMagnetVelocity`
  - `maxSugarcaneGrowthHeight`
  - `openDoubleDoors`
  - `solidHoney`

- 2 new **Tinker Kit** commands:
  - `/delay`
    - Controls the delay of the redstone component, inputted by registry ID.
  - `/tickpriority`
    - Controls the tick priority of certain scheduled ticks emitted by the redstone component, inputted by registry ID.
    - This requires that the same component's delay is set above 0.

- New modifiable **Tinker Kit** components. Since these are all input devices, they cannot be modified by `/quasiconnectivity`:
  - Pressure plates
  - Weighted pressure plates
  - Buttons
  - Tripwire hooks
  - Targets
  - Daylight detectors
  - Lightning rods
  - Lecterns
  - Detector rails
  - Trapped chests
***

### Removals
- 4 rules:
  - `maxMinecartSpeedLand` and `maxMinecartSpeedWater`
    - These was implemented in a way that was janky and unintuitive, so I just decided to remove them in favor of the gamerule coming soon anyway.
  - `obsidianFrameConversionChance`
    - The functionality is now part of `cryingObsidianPortalFrames`.
  - `copperBulbDelay`
    - Use `/delay set <value> <minecraft:copper_bulb|minecraft:waxed_copper_bulb|minecraft:oxidized_copper_bulb|...>` instead!
***

### Bug Fixes
- `/randomtick` no longer creates multiple tree structures from a single targetted sapling. #1 🎉🎉
- The **Tinker Kit** will no longer crash the game or spam the logs with error messages when activating certain components. #10 
- Improved the passive performance of barrels when `barrelItemDumping` is enabled.
- `disablePetAttacking` now works correctly.
- Redstone torches attached to the backs of pistons are now correctly affected by the `softInversion` setting.
- Certain rules will no longer get added to the [Carpet][carpet] registry if certain mods are installed on the server:
  - `sporeBlossomDuplication`  and [Florum Sporum][florum-sporum]
  - `reachAroundBridging`  and [BedrockIfy][bedrockify]

[carpet]: https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet
[florum-sporum]: https://modrinth.com/mod/florum-sporum
[bedrockify]: https://modrinth.com/mod/bedrockify

releases.notes:
The long-awaited 1.21 update is out, which means so too is another version of **Doormat**! You see, one of my favourite bugs in the game, [silly string], was patched for the end platform this update. However, with _the power of modding_, we can add it back!
***

### Changes
One of the lesser-used settings of **Doormat**, `propagulePropagation`, has received a minor touch-up to make it work more like how I intended when I first added it.

In case you're not in the know, `propagulePropagation` allows mangrove propagules to fall from mangrove trees and plant themselves, where they will then grow into more mangrove trees. The way I did this before was to summon a falling block entity, and check if it is a hanging mangrove propagule. If it is, set it to standing immediately so it satisfies its placement conditions upon hitting the ground. The problem with this was.. well.. it doesn't look very good.

Now, the propagules will stay in their hanging states during freefall, only righting themselves the moment they hit the ground. The code for this is a little more complex, but so worth it in my opinion!

Secondly, the `randomTicks` logger has been reworked to no longer be able to display randomTicked positions in the world with the `visual` setting. Now, the options are `brief` and `full`, which both behave very similarly to vanilla Carpet's `explosions` logger, displaying info in chat about successful randomTicks in the world.
***

### Additions
Added 3 new rules! As always, you can find more info about them in the wiki:
- `compactBannerTooltips`
- `endPlatformSillyString`
- `sneakingRandomTickChance`
***

### Removals
All client-side debug renderers have been removed due to some severe 1.21 issues I don't see myself fixing in the near future. They may return in the future, but for now we will have to make-do without.
***

### Bug Fixes
- The Tinker Kit now sends a warning in chat when a function is called on a block that isn't registered.
- `campfireRespawning` should no longer affect any and all respawning players, regardless of whether the spawnpoint was set at a campfire or even if the rule was disabled.
- `consistentExplosionImmunity` now correctly applies damage to non-item entities.

[silly string]: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UK0ITdepa24

releases.notes:
Back again! Did you miss me? :p

This minor release fixes two crashes and redesigns the way `compactEnchantTooltips` appear in order to make the number of applied enchantments more obvious at a glance.
***

### Changes
`compactEnchantTooltips` is now an enumerator setting, taking in `false`, `true` or `bar`. You do not need to re-input your old values as `true` will parse the same way as before.

`true` displays a fraction at the beginning of the enchantment name, like this:

```
5/8: Unbreaking III
```

`bar` doesn't affect the enchantment line. Instead, it shows a progress bar underneath, like this:

```
Unbreaking III
□□□□■□□□ (5/8)
```

The colors of each dot in the bar denote whether the enchantment at that ordinal is blessed (dark gray) or cursed (dark red).
***

### Bug Fixes
- The mixin for `compactEnchantTooltips` no longer has an erroneous `remap = false`, crashing the game. (#7)
- `min_inclusive` and `max_inclusive` int providers in custom configured features are no longer wrapped in an extra `value field`, crashing the game. (#8)

releases.notes:
Happy holidays! This update is for the same versions as the previous, but fixes a critical client-side issue when playing on a dedicated server, among other things. Even though it may seem small, I recommend you install it anyway just to save you unnecessary confusion in the future!
***

### Fixes
- #2 (Reported by [nickademas]) - Entities are no longer completely immune to explosions when `consistentExplosionImmunity` is disabled.
- #3 (Reported by [nickademas]) - Opening a fence gate or door crashes the client when playing on a dedicated server.
- 1.20.2 is no longer accepted as a valid client version for running this mod.
***

### Minor Changes
- Reduced the number of unnecessary code warnings by adding `@SuppressWarnings` annotations to a couple of functions.
- `PeacefulSpawningHelper.addSpawningCondition()` now uses a switch statement instead of an if-else chain.
- Config file saving and loading is now generally more robust, in case one of you does something more extreme than opening a fence gate! :p
***

It's a good time to mention that community experience is immensely valuable when it comes to making mods as polished as possible. While developing, it's easy to get caught in a loop where you don't think to test something specific because you've already seen it tens of times before! If you encounter a bug or come up with an idea for improvement, please contact me via the [GitHub issues page] and I'll be sure to look into it, like I did with nickademas' reports this week. Thank you, and enjoy your holidays! - axia 🌸

[nickademas]: https://github.com/nickademas
[GitHub issues page]: https://github.com/axialeaa/DoormatCarpetExtension/issues
